[b]THE MOSES PROTOCOL[/b]

The immediate threat of a pandemic virus spreading throughout the globe was quickly caught upon by the several external and internal intelligence groups, clandestine and official, of the Three Commonwealths, with Albany's Director informing his fellow Directors in Hithers and Averne about it. Their mutual history and copycat government hierarchy and agencies made it much easier for through-communication hotlines to be liked and a crisis conference carried out.

Out of all the Founders' Contingencies, ever since expanded from the days of royals and knights to the modern democracies and commonwealths, the vote landed unanimously with a three out of three on the [i]Moses Protocol[/i]; the Three Commonwealths will initiate emergency lockdown and shutdown state, triggering a state of emergency session in each nation, with a vote for Emergency Powers to the Avernal, Albic, and Hitheric Directors for a moment of crisis such as this.

A grand team of savants, scientists, experts, security officers, international agents, informants, and enough evidence to put or bury any party or petty personal animosity between the delegates of government in the legislation behind and bring up a more seamless vote. By the midday, the Global Emergency Act in Averne, the Grand Emergency Act in Albany, and the General Emergency Act in Hithers, all have passed with enough votes.

Immediately the arcane and scientific arsenal of the three nations is brought out, and citizens are recalled worldwide to confirm if they wish to return to either of the three nations to see if they are infected, and if not infected then permitted to return, or otherwise gamble at being left out. Massus of food, supply, equipment, and resources is being bought, secured, and installed. Trade will not be severely affected as much as severely monitored, secured, and protected.

[i]"In the struggle to protect our people; we will take any and all means necessary, for only when divided may these sacred commonwealth's fall."[/i]
[i][sub] Hitherlander Minister of Intelligence, latest interview.[/sub][/i]

Foreigners are being informed to either prepare for prolonged lodgings, or prepare themselves to leave. The commonwealths will help dispense compensation or otherwise help in transporting any foreign citizens in their soil. Furthermore the newly tri-state Anti Viral Task Force [i](AVTF)[/i] will enact the duty in ensuring to find any and all infected to properly quarantine them.

Across all three nations a curfew from 22:00 PM to 06:09 AM will be strictly enacted. The Arcane Ministry"s Department of Ancient Knowledge of High Albany will be working with their Hitheric and Avernal counterparts in, as of this afternoon, casting a wide regional protection spell, which shall illuminate the skyward reflection with a faint blue hue. This shield, the Arcane Commonwealth Tri-Shield (ACTS), will detect the health of every soul, not by name but by location, within the area it is above. Immediately warnings are given to all aircraft not belonging to the three nations to not fly over their airspace without permission, only national airships with the proper runic spellwork protections may fly, with the exception of low altitude aircraft. Internet and communication lines may fluctuate. Apologies are sent to immediate neighbours and nearby nations for the night-time permanent illumination.

As of this moment, the gates are barred.

[b]Thýven shifts doctrines[/b]
Due to the rapid expansion of TK and the war between the two nations, it became apparent to the government of Thýven, that as a result of being the only THEP nation on Elesyr, there was not enough of a powerbase to ensure the stability of THEP on Elesyr. 

The first matter would be the North Thýven question, peace had been established several months prior following a coup attempt on the presidency there, and as a result of some finagling internally, Thýven had managed to convince their northern counterpart with regionalised autonomy, in order to get them to return to the fold of mainland Thýven, thus permitting for a stronger northern front. However, the government was not done yet.

Following the reunification, or at least, planned reunification, the government of Thýven would then move to claim the Brn Corridor , a narrow strip of land between the Roskesak Republic and the northern lake that divided the two countries. This was to prevent further expansions and potential encirclement by any hostile nations or groups. 

The move into the Brn corridor would be supported by the 1st and 2nd National Border Regiments, consisting of 2,000 troops, 20 tanks. At the same time the 3rd Air Battalion would also provide backup support into the taking of the area. Marching across the border of Thýven they would move to neutralise any potential threats, capturing the farms and small villages of the region rather quickly, and dismantling the village structures and militias therein. 

Generally Thýven had a more assimilatory view of its captured land on Elesyr moving less to conquer but to permit cooperation and regional individuality to linger. As a result of this, the Brn Corridor would be granted semi-autonomous status as well being a duchy with crown powers over the residents of the region.

As a result of the newly acquired territory the legislature would convene to discuss changing the system to a more traditional system of nobility and land separation, proposing that In light of the need for strong government, traditional means of governance seem to stand fiercer than those of these modern governments,. 

While there would be concerns voiced about the viability of the matter, a temporary test of the proposed system would be made in the region of North Thýven, with ducal titles being awarded to the 7 former regional governors of that nation, and with Consantin VI agreeing to being crowned Ethnarch of Eldrín.
